content:
maria: heads up — noticed staging pods didn't pick up rotated secrets this morning after the Vault rotation. tokens rotated but pods still referencing old k8s secret. can someone sanity-check ExternalSecret -> Secret mapping?

ash: hm, any logs? controller version? we bumped externalsecret CRD in infra overlay last week.

maria: logs from externalsecret controller:
```
time=\"2026-03-01T09:12:23Z\" level=info msg=\"syncing ExternalSecret staging/payment-signer\"
time=\"2026-03-01T09:12:23Z\" level=error msg=\"no target refs found for vault path 'secret/data/services/payment'\"
```
thought the routing/SA annotation (`secret.kubernetes.io/service-account`) was used to fanout tokens to projected secrets — not sure why target refs missing.

ryan: I opened https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/324 which touched staging overlays. looks like the `serviceAccountRef` block was accidentally removed from the `ExternalSecret` template in the overlay.

ash: yep saw that. controller v0.8.1 expects `serviceAccountRef` while v0.9 switched to annotation `externalsecret.redwood/service-account` — staging is still on 0.8.1, so mismatch explains the error.

sara: quick fix — re-add `serviceAccountRef` to the staging overlay and apply. I can push a commit to the PR now. who can review?

maria: please @sara do it. also add a smokecheck snippet to the PR description: `kubectl get pods -l app=payment -o jsonpath='{.items[*].spec.containers[*].envFrom}'` and `kubectl describe secret payment-signer` to confirm propagation.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered: infra/staging overlay patch by sara (PR 324) — preview env created at https://staging-previews.redwood.internal/324

ryan: +1 on the patch. after deploy, run `kubectl exec -it payment-0 -- cat /etc/secrets/signer | head` to confirm the new token is mounted into the pod.

sara: patched and applied, running smoke now. will report back in ~10m :eyes:

maria: thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround :thumbsup:

sara: smoke ok — pods see the new token, rotation flow back to normal. adding a CI check to assert secret UID changes on rotation and documented the controller version compatibility in the overlay README. closing the thread.
